heading: The Marginarium: how it was made
first_line: Paul built Paint by Moonlight, an on-device photo-to-painting app, with a small team of AI agents; its Marginarium chapters tell how it was made.
content_why: Copied word for word, the chapters keep every name, date and claim exactly as written, and they are the only way a visitor without a Claude Docs account can read them.
avoid: Avoid decorative science: no method, model or paper the code does not really use, and no name or year that has not been checked against ACKNOWLEDGEMENTS.md.
